d:
This is my third imageset by fuzukikai. Someday I'll be better at drawing bubbles. I kind of get why most people do one, then stop. They're kind of samey, as far as the general plot goes. I quite like the formula, though, and they're quite easy to knock out, so another revisit is just kind of indvitable. Although next time I do an image set, it'll probably be Hayanye R again.

Next up is another big manga, but I'm making really good time, so it might be up as early as next week.

You can find the original here:

https://e-hentai.org/g/3712792/080b7bd35a/
